explanation: A title often used for God, referring to his sovereignty and authority.
Symbolizes God's royal power and dominion over the world and humanity.
The group of people subject to God's rule, both Israel and other nations.
To act in accordance with moral principles and ethical standards, which God expects from his followers.
Reflects God's grace, love, and compassion toward people, especially when they turn to him in repentance and conversion.
An expression of gratitude and reverence to God through prayer, song, or other forms of worship.
An attribute describing God's purity and perfection, as well as separation from sin and evil.
A reference to the patriarch Jacob, a central figure in Israel's history and God's promises to his descendants.
God's ability to protect, support, and help his people in difficult times and situations.
